record.hypothesis: New deployment/packaging candidate · P1 · PROPOSED / NOT TESTED Extends: R06, R09. Reference primitives: S2, S3, S10. Question. Can a tightly scoped MP4 preparation route avoid downloading or compiling a Wasm muxer when controlled MSE playback is needed? Mechanism. Parse the selected ordinary-MP4 sample tables in JavaScript and construct small fMP4 headers around the unchanged compressed samples. This differs from R09, which only forwards media that is already fragmented.
